title: Releases
intro: Your singles, EPs and albums: the tracks in order, where each one stands, what's left before the date. Everything stays in the app: no file moves.
firstText: Group songs into a single, EP or album to follow where each track stands and what's left before the release date.
hintsTitle: Your folders that look like releases
hintsText: Their name says EP, LP or album. Making one a release takes its songs in the order of their names; you can reorder them afterwards.

page.arrangeTitle: Put the folders of its songs into one folder on disk
page.physOff: Physical arranging is turned off: for now this release only exists in the app and no file moves. To arrange its folders on disk, turn it on in {link}.
page.nothingAlready: Nothing to move: its songs are already in "{target}".
page.nothingCant: Nothing to move: no folder can be moved.

movesExisting.one: The folder of {n} song will go into the folder:

page.checked: Every project is checked: a project that would lose a sample is not moved. Ctrl+Z puts everything back.
